summary: Automation built-in nodes: set (CEL values), code (sandboxed TS/JS with declared secrets, env.fetch and env.connections through a connector's CodeAccessor, compiled on save, its step context kept out of the call's instance input), http (guarded HTTPS with secret or connection auth bound to a static host, same-origin redirects for connections, success expression, body template), start_automation and run_automation (another graph's enabled version through its «Called by an automation» or manual trigger, Automations.Operate, cascade depth, cancelled with the parent), and the action node with the SDK action registry (actions.Contribute, native command contracts called through wf.call with the call's InvocationID): core.user.block/unblock, core.group.add_user/remove_user and crm.chat.send_message; tenant secrets CONNECTION__FIELD from connections; graph map params ("*" paths), Dispatch, OutputKeys, StepContext and wait outcomes; engine NodeValidator, EffectWaitKeyer, WakeResolver, StartFromStep and Config.Commands.
